abilities.description: Spots discrepancies between certified copies and surviving originals, including inconsistencies in dates, signatures, and wording.
abilities.name: Record comparison

abilities.description: Knows how daylight signatures and witness requirements determine whether a civic record becomes legally binding.
abilities.name: Procedural fluency

characters.arc: Mara begins by believing that a correct process can protect her from responsibility. When the salt line appears on the supposedly untouched original, she must choose whether to let the audit endorse the transcript or publicly withdraw her certification. She withdraws it and names her own part in the error, ending as an examiner willing to risk her standing to distinguish evidence from authority.
characters.description: Mara Vell is a registry examiner from Morrow Quay who learned to trust neat columns more than the people who filled them in. She certified the archivist's supposed resignation and now sees her signature on a page that the tide is beginning to mark. Spare and impeccably dressed in a rain-dark coat, with ink caught permanently in the creases of her fingers, Mara carries herself like a form that has already been approved. Her knowledge of filing procedure makes her useful to the audit and makes every attempt to correct the record look like an admission of guilt.
characters.external_conflict: The Office of Final Copies expects her to defend the transcript, while the tide is leaving salt on the original and the audit deadline is closing in.
characters.flaw: She treats procedure as a substitute for moral judgment and hesitates whenever a truthful choice would expose her own mistake.
characters.goal: Determine who changed the archivist's death record before the audit endorses the transcript.
characters.internal_conflict: Mara wants to believe she is a careful examiner, but her certification helped turn an altered record into civic truth.
characters.motivation: To preserve the public's ability to tell an official record from a convenient fiction.
characters.name: Mara Vell

abilities.description: Interprets pressure-bell and lantern sequences, while accounting for the seven-breath echo during which no lantern signal can be trusted.
abilities.name: Signal reading

abilities.description: Understands the skybridge's maintenance routines and how its signals affect crossings.
abilities.name: Bridge maintenance

characters.arc: Orin begins convinced that keeping the signal sequence secret is the only way to shield the Bellkeepers. When Mara asks him to stand as a witness to the original record, he must decide whether to change the bells and risk exposure or let the audit bury the evidence. He reveals the sequence and its consequences, ending willing to share responsibility rather than use silence as protection.
characters.description: Orin Dask is a senior Bellkeeper responsible for the pressure bells and lantern signals at Crown Spindle. He remembers the bridge's opening promise that visibility would make secrets harder to keep, and has spent years learning how easily a signal can make a crowd look the other way. Broad-shouldered and weathered, he wears a brass bell key on a cord and watches the skybridge before he watches the people crossing it. He knows the sequence that could delay the audit, but changing it would reveal who ordered the bridge lights dark during the archivist's last crossing.
characters.external_conflict: The Registry wants the audit to proceed on its preferred transcript, while changing the bell sequence would expose the order behind the darkened skybridge.
characters.flaw: He hoards information and mistakes silence for control.
characters.goal: Delay the audit long enough to establish who ordered the bridge lights dark.
characters.internal_conflict: Orin wants to protect his fellow tenders, yet his refusal to speak has preserved the same secrecy that lets others manipulate the city's warnings.
characters.motivation: To keep the Bellkeepers from becoming the city's convenient scapegoat for every hidden decision.
characters.name: Orin Dask

abilities.description: Can frame procedural decisions as protections for public confidence and draw officials into defending the Registry's position.
abilities.name: Institutional persuasion

abilities.description: Understands how timing, witnesses, and daylight signatures affect whether a civic record becomes binding.
abilities.name: Audit strategy

characters.arc: Sera begins certain that a clean official answer is kinder than public doubt. When Mara withdraws her certification and Orin reveals the signal sequence, Sera must choose whether to defend the transcript or disclose what the Registry knew before the audit. She discloses the withheld correspondence, ending with her authority diminished but no longer secured by a fiction.
characters.description: Sera Noll is a senior certifier in the Office of Final Copies and the chief advocate for endorsing the archivist's resignation transcript. She helped make certified copies the city's dependable answer after the Archive Flood and believes public confidence is too fragile to survive every inconvenient original. At the audit table she appears composed, with silver-rimmed spectacles, dry cuffs, and a stack of papers aligned so precisely that even her pauses seem filed. Sera did not create every part of the deception, but she chose to preserve it and has built her authority around the claim that the record is settled.
characters.external_conflict: Mara's comparison of the transcript with the salt-marked original threatens the endorsement, and Orin's knowledge of the signal sequence may connect the Registry to the darkened bridge.
characters.flaw: She confuses institutional stability with truth and rationalizes each concealment as a necessary exception.
characters.goal: Secure the audit's endorsement of the resignation transcript before the tide exposes more of the original.
characters.internal_conflict: Sera knows the transcript's certainty depends on suppressing evidence, but admitting that would force her to question the post-flood order she has spent her career defending.
characters.motivation: To maintain the Registry's authority and prevent a disputed record from undermining the civic system she helped build.
characters.name: Sera Noll

relationships.description: Mara Vell needs Orin Dask's account of the skybridge signals to test the transcript, while Orin distrusts the Registry examiner whose signature helped certify it.
Mara Vell's attempt to correct the record directly threatens Sera Noll's effort to secure the audit's endorsement.
Sera Noll wants the audit settled before Orin Dask reveals the bell sequence that could expose the order to darken the bridge.
